draft.shortGloss: to try; to taste; to try on; to test
draft.emotion: inquisitive and focused, sensing something for the first time
notes: Covers trying out a thing, food, or clothes. For making an effort to do something ('try hard to'), προσπαθώ is more common, though δοκιμάζω να... is used for 'try doing something to see what happens'.

senses.definition: To use, do, or put on something (such as clothes) to see if it works, suits you, or is good.

examples.text: Θέλω να δοκιμάσω αυτό το καινούργιο πρόγραμμα στον υπολογιστή.
examples.translation: I want to try out this new computer program.
examples.emotion: eager and curious, ready to explore a new tool

examples.text: Μπορώ να δοκιμάσω αυτό το πουκάμισο;

senses.definition: To sample a small amount of food or drink to check its flavor.

examples.text: Δοκιμάζω τη σούπα για να δω αν χρειάζεται αλάτι.

examples.emotion: thoughtful and careful, evaluating a balance of flavours
